subject: table, executor: let `SplitIndexValue` work with clustered index table. (#53254)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for `pkg/tablecodec/tablecodec.go`, `pkg/executor/{point_get,batch_point_get,mem_reader}.go`, and `pkg/table/tables/index.go`. `tablecodec.SplitIndexValue` now correctly decodes clustered-index (index value version=1) segments (CommonHandle/PartitionID/RestoredValues), enabling global-index PointGet/BatchPointGet/mem-index readers to route to the right partition and (in mem reader) fail fast on unexpected PID decode errors. The removal of the mem-buffer PID guard in `index.Delete` appears safe given current DML ordering (partition-move update does delete-then-add; REPLACE deletes duplicates before insert) and uniqueness checks, and I found no remaining plausible Blocker/High issues in correctness/semantics/consistency/txn behavior within the touched scope.
